children: Overview
UK technology provider's H1 2026 revenue was flat yr/yr, while recurring revenue grew 4.6%
Gross margin declined due to expensing development salaries and salary inflation
Adjusted EBITDA fell sharply from a year earlier
Outlook
Touchstar expects H2 2026 revenue to be slightly lower than H1 2026
Company anticipates FY 2026 loss will be lower than previous market expectation
Touchstar aims to return to profitability in 2027
Result Drivers
ACCOUNTING CHANGE - Co said gross margin declined mainly due to expensing development salaries following impairment of intangible assets
SALARY INFLATION - Co said salary inflation and higher employer National Insurance contributions further reduced gross margin
COMMERCIAL MODEL TRANSITION - Co said shift to office-based internal sales structure moderated short-term order intake and revenue growth
